details:
Behavior:

1. Create a new world instance and attempt to join it (either by instance switching or joining a friend’s instance).

2. The screen fades to black.

3. The loading screen appears, showing the thumbnail of the Home world.

4. The user is returned to the Home world.

Current findings:

- Changing the server region has no effect.

- There is no difference between joining directly from the UI and joining via a portal.

- Restarting VRChat has no effect.

- Sometimes the transfer works; sometimes it doesn't.

- If the Home world is set to Friend+ or similar beforehand, other users are able to join the redirected world.

- This issue seems more likely to occur on the first instance switch after launching VRChat... (maybe)
title: Instance Join Failure, Unexpected Redirect to Home
